verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service platform, so interest-bearing accounts and sweeps are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows that SAVING and CHECKING account types exist as demand deposit accounts. Nothing in the pack documents interest accrual, rate mechanics, sweep programs, or who keeps the spread, and an account-type label alone does not show that balances earn.

support.subject: As a finance lead, idle balances can earn — interest-bearing accounts or documented sweep options, with the rate mechanics and who keeps the spread spelled out
